This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Senior Technical Recruiter
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter to join our Global Talent Acquisition team and drive the growth of our North American teams, specifically in our San Francisco office. Our company empowers you to implement your ideas, take ownership of your career, and continuously learn.

You'll experience a fast-paced, open-minded work environment that fosters innovation and collaboration. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you will collaborate closely with our hiring teams to spot, attract, and hire top talent, playing a pivotal role in shaping the future of our growing organization.

You have a minimum of 7 years experience in Technical Recruitment - expertise in hiring for Engineering, Product, Design and/or Data focused roles preferred;
Passionate about Recruitment with a deep understanding of the tech landscape and candidate market; Fintech/Payments experience and knowledge of the local SF market is greatly appreciated!
Utilize analytics to inform hiring strategies and improve recruitment outcomes;
Highly self-motivated with the ability to define structure and prioritize tasks effectively;
Deep knowledge of recruitment sourcing strategies and ability to nurture a passive candidate talent pool
Additional Information
The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $195,000; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here .
This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team
The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity.

We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and talent development practices. .Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda.

Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.
The Opportunity
Help build the teams powering Agoda’s global partner network
Agoda is a digital travel platform that helps people experience the world for less. Our Supply organization builds and strengthens Agoda’s global network of accommodation and travel partners, supporting areas such as partner operations, account management, business development, commercial strategy, and market growth.
As an Associate Talent Acquisition Partner supporting Supply, you will manage recruitment for assigned roles and help attract the talent that enables Agoda to grow its partner network and deliver value to partners and travelers worldwide.
You will work closely with candidates, Hiring Managers, recruiters, coordinators, and People Team partners to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes—efficiently, fairly, and with care.

Manage assigned recruitment processes end to end, from intake through offer and pre-onboarding.
Partner with Supply Hiring Managers to understand hiring needs, provide pipeline updates, and keep recruitment moving.
Deliver against agreed hiring targets, SLAs, timelines, and quality expectations.
Create a clear, professional, and engaging experience for every candidate.
Monitor pipeline health, funnel conversion, candidate freshness, Time in Stage, and offer acceptance.
Use data to identify risks and recommend practical actions to improve hiring outcomes.
Identify and escalate challenges such as low pipeline quality, candidate drop-off, delayed feedback, or interviewer availability.
Maintain accurate recruitment records and follow Agoda’s hiring policies, scorecard standards, and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with Recruitment Operations, Coordination, Offers, Onboarding, Global Mobility, Compensation and Benefits, HRBP, and other People Team partners.
Contribute to sourcing activities, recruitment events, referrals, team initiatives, and process improvements.
Actively seek feedback and build expertise in sourcing, screening, structured interviewing, stakeholder management, candidate experience, and recruitment analytics.

Ability to manage multiple roles, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using data, dashboards, spreadsheets, or recruitment systems.
Strong attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information.
Curiosity, resilience, ownership, and willingness to learn.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment.

Experience managing requisitions or end-to-end recruitment processes.
Experience hiring for commercial, account management, business development, partner management, or operations roles.
Experience with an Applicant Tracking System.
Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as Time to Hire, Time to Fill, Offer Acceptance, Interview 1 to Hire, Time in Stage, and Candidate Freshness.

What’s in It for you?
Named Forbes World's Best Employers 2025 & TIME World's Best Companies 2025!
Colliers Balance - to support lifestyle & wellbeing.
Wide range of benefits and discounts designed to support your career, wellbeing, and lifestyle.
Industry leading leave – including 26 weeks of parental leave, additional paid leave, volunteering, and loyalty leave.
Formal career development & recognition programs.
Innovative technology & tools to drive your productivity.

Generate employment contract documentation, ensuring successful candidates and hiring managers are aware of terms and conditions of employment.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription.

Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced.

Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Proven track record of ensuring a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Fluency in English and German is required . Additional proficiency in either French or Spanish is preferred.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and fluency in English and German are mandatory requirements.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Responsibilities New business development – Follow up with client leads Collaborate with hiring managers to write job ads for current openings Advertise and update job openings on GVW’s career pages, job boards and social networks (e.g.

Source candidates through online channels (e.g. professional networks and portfolio sites) Screen resumes and applications and update candidates on hiring processes Preparing CV’s for submission to clients Interview candidates during various hiring stages, via virtual platforms.

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Hiring exceptional talent is one of the most important ways we pursue this mission, and our Recruiting Coordination team plays a critical role in ensuring a world-class candidate and stakeholder experience throughout the hiring process.
We’re seeking a Recruiting Coordinator Lead to join our team and help scale and strengthen recruiting operations across OpenAI. This role will partner closely with recruiters, sourcers, interviewers, hiring managers, recruiting leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive operational excellence, improve coordination processes, and support efficient, scalable hiring practices.
This role goes beyond scheduling execution — we are looking for a highly experienced coordination leader who can design scalable coordination practices, identify systemic inefficiencies, influence process changes across teams, and help raise the operational bar across the coordination organization.

s.h: As a Recruiting Coordinator Lead, you will
s.t:
Lead scalable recruiting coordination practices across multiple technical business functions and hiring pipelines, ensuring operations are efficient, consistent, and candidate-first.
Act as a strategic partner on recruiting operations challenges, helping identify scalable solutions through data, tools, process improvements, and cross-functional collaboration.
Partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, recruiting leadership, and Executive Operations teams to support hiring goals and drive operational excellence.
Act as a trusted operational lead within the coordination organization by both managing and mentoring coordinators, driving consistency, and helping establish scalable best practices.
Support interviewer enablement efforts including interviewer training logistics, onboarding coordination, interviewer pool management, and load balancing support.
Use tools such as Ashby, Guide, ChatGPT, Google Workspace, Slack, Navan, Reimbi and Notion to support a timely, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
Manage professional, timely, and candidate-first communication with candidates and stakeholders across written and verbal channels.
Coordinate onsite interview logistics, candidate travel, and reimbursement processes, including domestic and international travel support.
Identify systemic operational gaps, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend scalable improvements that support long-term recruiting growth.
Navigate ambiguity, shifting priorities, and fast-moving hiring environments while influencing stakeholders to adopt consistent and scalable coordination practices.

5+ years of recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, or related experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.
1.5+ years of experience managing or leading recruiting coordinators, contingent workforce teams, or recruiting operations in a high-volume environment.
Significant experience supporting multiple technical business functions and hiring teams with varying operational needs and stakeholder styles.
Proven expertise managing high-volume and complex technical scheduling.
Experience supporting interviewer load balancing strategies or recruiting capacity planning efforts.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to build trust and influence across recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
Demonstrated track record of improving coordination workflows, operational processes, or recruiting systems at scale.
Expertise with tools such as Google Calendar, Guide, Ashby, Slack, Notion, Navan, Reimbi and Google Workspace, with demonstrated ability to handle high-volume tasks efficiently.
Highly organized with strong prioritization skills and the ability to adapt quickly in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and solutions-oriented when addressing operational challenges.
Collaborative mindset with a passion for improving processes, documentation, and team operations.
High level of professionalism and discretion when supporting senior leadership and executive-level candidates.

Experience supporting hypergrowth or rapidly scaling recruiting organizations.
Advanced technical knowledge of tools used for process automation, reporting, or operational optimization in recruiting.

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.
Why this role exists
selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.
We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.
This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.
What you will work on
Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract
Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles
Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search
Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality
Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage
Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure
Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards
Must-haves
Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer
Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently
Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS
Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions
KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain
German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages
Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication
Nice-to-haves
Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment
Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination
Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee
Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles
How we work
selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.
Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.
There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.
Working conditions
Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin
Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows
Contract: Permanent employment
Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale.

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency.

Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
Company Operating Rhythm
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for our most complex and high-impact engineering roles — spanning customer-facing and core platform teams — across both US and international markets. You'll help Deepgram scale by building pipelines for AI-native technical talent across geographies, navigating regional market dynamics, and partnering closely with the team on compliant, scalable hiring practices.
This role requires fluency in how AI products are built and deployed, strong judgment on technical bar, and a systems-level view of recruiting — not just within one market, but across time zones, cultures, and the specialized talent communities that define the frontier of voice AI and applied machine learning.

Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and hard-to-fill technical roles across Research, Engineering, and Product teams.

Build proactive sourcing strategies for niche and senior-level technical talent in the US and abroad.
Evaluate candidates for technical depth, impact, and alignment with Deepgram’s values across different cultural and regional contexts.
Deliver a high-quality candidate experience across time zones through clear communication, thoughtful process design, and operational rigor.
Use data and funnel metrics to diagnose issues, improve signal quality, and increase hiring velocity globally.
Collaborate with People Ops, Legal, and Finance to support compliant global hiring (employment models, offers, and regional considerations).
Help evolve recruiting infrastructure, tools, and interview practices to support international scale.

Hands-on experience leading global expansion efforts, including hiring across multiple countries or regions.
Experience recruiting for at least two of the following domains: Customer Engineering / Solutions Engineering, Backend / Platform Infrastructure, Product Engineering, or Developer-facing roles.
Strong technical literacy — you don't need to code, but you should understand how modern software systems, APIs, and customer-integrated technical products are built. We are an AI-native company and believe in the future of these products.
Proven ability to source and close senior-level and highly specialized technical talent in competitive, international markets, particularly for roles that sit at the intersection of technical depth and customer impact.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping teams sharpen what "good" looks like across different regions and customer segments.

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling.

Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases.

You'll be great for this role if…

· You have a proven track record of managing full-cycle talent acquisition for complex Engineering, Product, Data, and Design roles within fast-moving tech or fintech environments.

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.
Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.

Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset: our people. Across our global teams, the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment, new staff orientation, compensation, training and development.

They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions, and they’re responsible for supporting their development, nurturing their skills and talent, and retaining the world-class people already on our team.

s.h: TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER II / SENIOR – TEMPORARY
s.t:
Rocket Lab is on a mission to redefine access to space, and we need exceptional talent to get there. As a Talent Acquisition Sourcer , based on-site at Rocket Lab Headquarters in Long Beach, CA, you’ll be at the forefront of building the teams that drive our innovation.

This strategic, hands-on sourcing position involves partnering closely with production department recruiters and leaders to define candidate profiles, develop innovative search strategies, and build pipelines of both active and passive candidates.
We seek a career Sourcer with experience identifying top-tier talent for complex technical and engineering roles in fast-paced manufacturing environments. In this role you will leverage advanced sourcing tools to uncover hard-to-find talent in aerospace, defense, and cutting-edge technology.

If you have deep expertise with sourcing platforms, a passion for connecting with passive candidates, and the drive to operate with urgency and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape this role and make a huge impact on our sourcing strategies and capabilities!
*This is a 6-month fixed-term role for immediate hire, with the potential opportunity to convert to full-time employment upon term completion. This role sits onsite at our Long Beach, CA headquarters – remote work is not considered for this position.
*Please note this position can be hired at the Talent Acquisition Sourcer II or Senior Talent Acquisition Sourcer I level.

Lead strategic sourcing initiatives for technical roles, utilizing advanced sourcing tools and techniques, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and niche industry platforms.
Own search strategy development, proactive outreach campaigns, and initial candidate assessments to ensure a consistent flow of high-quality candidates.
Engage and convert passive candidates through creative outreach, referral campaigns, and relationship building, while promoting Rocket Lab’s employer brand.
Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for hard-to-fill, niche, or high-priority roles, ensuring long-term alignment with future hiring needs.
Conduct high-level candidate screening and interviews, assessing skills, motivations, and cultural fit to achieve strong interview-to-offer ratios.
Provide market intelligence and talent mapping, offering insights into talent availability, competitor trends, and compensation benchmarks.
Collaborate closely with recruiters and hiring managers to define candidate personas, calibrate search efforts, and provide timely updates on pipeline progress.
Champion diversity sourcing strategies and ensure an outstanding candidate experience at every touchpoint.
Contribute to recruitment marketing efforts, including social media outreach, university events, and talent community engagement.
Track and report on key sourcing metrics, continuously optimizing processes and strategies for better outcomes.
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER II:
2+ years of full-time experience as a dedicated Talent Acquisition Sourcer, within aerospace, defense, technology, or other high growth industry and a bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of work experience (6+ years total experience).
Proven expertise sourcing for technical and niche engineering roles.
Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms and strategies.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, or similar.
Track record of building pipelines for passive candidates through creative sourcing, networking, and engagement campaigns.
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER I:
5+ years of full-time experience as a dedicated Talent Acquisition Sourcer, within aerospace, defense, technology, or other high growth industry and a bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of work experience (9+ years total experience).
Proven expertise sourcing for technical and niche engineering roles.
Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms and strategies.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, or similar.
Track record of building pipelines for passive candidates through creative sourcing, networking, and engagement campaigns.

Demonstrated success in market research, talent insights, and competitor intelligence to drive data-driven recruiting decisions.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to effectively present Rocket Lab’s value proposition to top talent.
Strong time and project management skills, thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while managing multiple roles simultaneously.
Creative, resourceful, and highly motivated with a sense of urgency and ownership.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with hiring managers, directors, and executives to define hiring needs and strategies.
Deep understanding of complex engineering principles and technical job profiles.

Source and engage high-quality software engineering talent across multiple markets
Partner closely with hiring managers and founders on hiring strategy and talent calibration
Assess candidate quality through career progression, technical depth, and execution signals
Drive interview coordination, candidate management, and closing processes
Improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring quality
Build strong pipelines for backend, mobile, desktop, and product engineering talent
What You'll Need
Proven experience recruiting software engineering talent in technology companies
Strong sourcing and talent mapping capability across global markets
Good understanding of engineering roles, technical stacks, and organizational structures
Ability to identify high-quality talent beyond pedigree and company brands
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and candidate engagement ability
Comfortable operating in fast-moving and ambiguous environments
High ownership and strong execution ability
How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution. This is a hands-on environment.

Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. Originally posted on Himalayas

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenLabs is building one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies - and we're looking for a GTM Recruiter to partner with our Revenue org. You'll run full-cycle recruiting across our high volumes roles, partnering with leaders across our Sales Development, Corporate, Mid-Market, and Partnerships team to hire world class talent.
This isn't a conventional recruiting role. You'll work alongside GTM leaders to shape role strategy, design world class candidate experiences, and close exceptional talent across North America. You know what great looks like in a Revenue org - whether from building GTM teams at exceptional tech companies or from your own experience exceeding hiring goals. This role is centered around high ownership, making data driven decisions, and building hiring processes and pipelines that scale.

s.h: What your day might look like
s.t:
Full-cycle recruiting for a broad range of GTM roles including Sales Development Representatives, Account Executives, and Revenue Partnerships.
Partnering closely with GTM leadership to refine role requirements, set hiring strategy, and identify key success signals that elevate quality of hire.
Designing and managing candidate pipelines with a focus on efficiency, transparency, and a white glove, high touch experience.
Acting as a trusted advisor to hiring teams, providing market insights, role benchmarks, and data-driven recommendations.
Representing ElevenLabs externally - every interaction with candidates is an opportunity to bring our brand and values to life.

Full-cycle GTM recruiting experience for a high growth startup, with a strong track record closing quota-carrying roles across Sales roles.
Able to manage high volume and complex searches across multiple priorities without sacrificing quality or urgency.
Strong partner to hiring leaders - you influence with clarity, data, and operational rigor.
Exceptional communicator - you craft compelling role narratives and deliver a high-touch experience for candidates and stakeholders alike.
Preference for this role to be based in New York City.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with candidates based in New York City strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office.

Who Are We?
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Talent Researcher to join our TA team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the top-of-funnel sourcing efforts to build a strong talent pipeline for technical and business functions. You will partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and business leaders to create and execute targeted sourcing strategies that attract diverse, high-caliber talent across key roles.

Lead proactive sourcing efforts for key technical and business roles, including Software Engineers, Product roles, and other critical functions across different teams.
Partner with hiring teams to understand role requirements and team culture, ensuring sourcing strategies align with business needs.
Map talent across our target companies in specific geographies and come up with clever ways to engage them.
Utilize a variety of sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, Boolean search, events, networking) to engage and attract passive candidates.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of talent, focusing on both current and future hiring needs.
Conduct initial candidate outreach, screening, and assessment to ensure alignment with role requirements and team dynamics.
Collaborate closely with recruiters to manage candidate flow and ensure timely movement through the hiring process.
Maintain an organized and efficient ATS (Greenhouse), ensuring all candidate data is up to date and tracked accurately.
Analyze data and market trends to refine sourcing strategies and improve the quality of candidates being sourced.
Provide a seamless, high-touch candidate experience from initial contact through the early stages of the recruitment process.

7+ years of sourcing experience, with a proven track record of identifying and engaging top talent in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Strong experience sourcing for technical roles (e.g., Software Engineers, Applied Engineers, Product Designers) and other business functions (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Operations).
Expertise in using advanced sourcing tools and platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, X-ray search, Boolean search, Gem, etc.).
Highly proficient in using AI and Agents to research, map and identify hard to find talent
Excellent understanding of the tech talent landscape, market trends, and competitor hiring strategies.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to influence hiring managers and recruiters based on market insights and candidate availability.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Data-driven approach to sourcing, with experience using metrics to optimize processes and improve results.
Outstanding communication skills with a focus on delivering a world-class candidate experience.
What Else?
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend.

Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about.

We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year.

We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
Equal opportunity
Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Riot Games Shanghai is both our China publishing headquarters and a world-class development studio shaping the future of play. Located in downtown Shanghai with a stunning view of the Bund, our office is a hub for creativity, innovation, and collaboration. With the launch of Shanghai Game Studio in 2021 and the expansion of the China Game Studio Group in 2022, we continue to grow our capabilities and build games that will inspire players for decades.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, game-loving professionals who challenge convention, take play seriously, and are ready to help us make bold ideas a reality.
That's where you come in.

We build strong partnerships with our teams, deeply understand their needs, and guide them through every stage of the hiring journey. Our recruiters act as brand ambassadors, problem solvers, and advocates for an outstanding candidate experience, while continually improving how we recruit across Riot.

You'll partner closely with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to attract and hire exceptional talent across a wide range of disciplines.

Drawing on your recruiting expertise, you'll develop sourcing strategies, advise hiring teams on market insights and hiring approaches, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Your work will play a critical role in building high-performing teams that create exceptional experiences for players around the world.
You will report to the APAC Recruiting Lead.

Lead full-cycle recruitment for both contract and full-time hiring across multiple game development disciplines.
Partner with hiring managers and business stakeholders to develop hiring strategies and deliver against hiring goals.
Build and maintain diverse, high-quality talent pipelines through proactive sourcing of passive candidates globally.
Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including intake meetings, sourcing, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination.

Partner with People team stakeholders to continuously improve recruiting operations, onboarding, and workforce planning initiatives.
Leverage recruiting metrics, market insights, and talent intelligence to inform hiring strategies and improve recruiting outcomes
Ensure recruiting practices align with Riot's hiring standards, compliance requirements, and business objectives.

Experience recruiting for both contract/contingent and full-time positions.
Experience recruiting across disciplines such as Art, Design, Production, Software Engineering, and Insights.
Demonstrated success developing sourcing strategies and building passive candidate pipelines.
Experience partnering with hiring managers and senior leaders to influence hiring decisions and talent strategies.
Strong knowledge of recruiting best practices, interview processes, and candidate experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Finding Candidates: - Lead a detailed job scope meeting with the hiring leader to determine position specifications, providing relevant market data and recommendations on possible approaches to the search or candidate requirements.
Review of candidates who have applied via the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements and determine who to move forward in the recruitment process.
Develop and manage recruitment marketing plans or sourcing plans to determine the most appropriate candidate sources that align to the search requirements.
Source candidates via resume databases, search engine and networking sites using Boolean search language.
Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.
Utilize Cielo ’s proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.
Engaging Candidates: - Use an appropriate mix of media to connect with talent communities (phone, email, social media, etc.).
Articulate value proposition to candidates who are interested in the job opportunity.
Prepare candidates for interviews, coaching them on logistical information, interview schedule, appropriate attire and overall expectations.
Ensure candidates are provided with timely updates concerning the status of their applications and interviews.

Use independent judgement to compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with position requirements to determine if the candidate is a match for the role or a potential match for other open positions.
Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).
Review background and reference information (if process dictates).
Influencing the Hire: - Keep candidates engaged throughout process, ensuring consistent communication on the status of the search.
Partner with hiring leader to determine offer details, using market data and compensation guidelines to support recommendations.
Articulate a job offer to candidate and drive for candidate acceptance, anticipating and negotiating counter-offers as appropriate.

Who we are
Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched. Tables run every clinical trial, every financial model, every scientific experiment, every business decision, and no one had built a foundation model that truly understood them.
Until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. The next modality shift in AI is happening, and we're hiring the team that makes it.
Momentum. We pioneered tabular foundation models and are now the world-leading organization in structured-data ML. Our TabPFN v2 model was published as a Nature cover story and set a new state of the art for tabular machine learning.

Since release we've scaled model capabilities 20x+, passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and are seeing accelerating adoption across research and industry - from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi to improving clinical-trial decisions with BostonGene .
The hardest work is ahead. We're scaling tabular foundation models to millions of rows, thousands of features, real-time inference, and entirely new data modalities, while building the infrastructure to run them in production across some of the most demanding industries on earth. These are open problems no one else is working on at this level.
Our team. We're a small, highly selective team of 30+ engineers, researchers, and GTM specialists, with backgrounds spanning Google, Apple, Amazon, DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft Research, G-Research, Jane Street, Goldman Sachs, and CERN. We're led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by world-leading AI researchers including Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. We ship fast, do top-tier research, and hold each other to an extremely high bar.
What's next. In 2025 we raised €9m pre-seed led by Balderton Capital, backed by leaders from Hugging Face, DeepMind, and Black Forest Labs. The next phase of growth is here, which makes this an ideal time to join.

Team Collaboration Skills: You thrive in a collaborative environment and are capable of working effectively with other team members to accomplish mutual goals. Your positive and supportive attitude contributes to a cohesive team dynamic.
Communication Skills: Your friendly and outgoing personality, coupled with your strong verbal and written communication skills, allows you to maintain a positive attitude even under pressure. You excel at building rapport with patients and colleagues alike.
Adaptability: You are adaptable and flexible, able to navigate changing priorities and evolving research protocols. Your ability to maintain excellent customer service regardless of circumstances is highly valued.

**Join Our Talent Acquisition Team!**
We are looking for an experienced and driven **Regional Recruiter** to help attract, engage, and hire top talent across our organisation. As a trusted partner to hiring managers and business leaders, you will play a key role in shaping recruitment strategies, building strong talent pipelines, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to offer negotiation and hiring.

* Conduct candidate interviews and assessments to ensure high-quality hiring decisions.
* Drive a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Support recruitment projects, process improvements, and employer branding initiatives.
* Leverage market insights and talent trends to influence hiring strategies.

* Minimum 8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including senior-level or hard-to-fill positions.

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment.

* Work in a dynamic, international environment.
* Partner directly with business leaders and influence hiring decisions.
* Play a key role in attracting talent that drives business success.
* Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and development.

## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line brand is expanding its Procurement team in the USA. Reporting to the MSC USA Procurement Manager, the Purchasing Agent is responsible for managing transactional procurement requests, including purchase order creation, order tracking, and timely processing of requisitions.

This role monitors delivery status and provides timely updates to stakeholders, while collaborating with the Sourcing, Logistics, Planning and Product teams to ensure the proper execution of the ordering process.

The Purchasing Agent also liaises with shipboard personnel to support efficient ordering and loading operations for U.S.-based vessels and MSC Ocean Cay.
This is a hybrid position requiring employees to work from the Miami office four days per week (Monday through Thursday), with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

* Review requisitions (RDA) received from shipboard personnel prior to purchase order creation.
* Create purchase orders and monitor order status throughout the purchasing lifecycle.
* Report shortages and delays to the Procurement Manager to support corrective action and local sourcing when required.
* Provide ongoing support for contracted and non-contracted purchasing requests.
* Follow up with suppliers on deliveries prior to vessel loadings.
* Reconcile invoices and resolve discrepancies related to goods received and payment issues.
* Resolve supplier issues related to delays and discrepancies in accordance with Procurement procedures.
* Maintain accurate and current information within the Company-s ERP, Procurement e-Platform and Discrepancy Reports.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Logistics, Planning, Product and shipboard teams to support efficient ordering and loading operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve service levels, reduce order processing costs and lead times, minimize supply chain waste and support cost-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. federal laws and MSC policies and procedures.
## Your Journey so far ##
* College degree required, preferably in Finance, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 2-3 years of purchasing experience; cruise line industry experience is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

s.h: * Knowledge of ERP systems such as Crunchtime is preferred.
s.t:
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities**.**

* US Passport or US Permanent Resident

It is our policy to employ and promote qualified candidates without discrimination on the basis of race, color, sex, age, origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications and business needs.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

s.t: Nous sommes fiers de gérer un portefeuille d'hôtels uniques, réputés pour leur hospitalité, leur qualité et leur ambiance authentique. Chacun de nos établissements offre non seulement une atmosphère particulière à nos clients, mais aussi des opportunités professionnelles exceptionnelles pour des talents engagés et compétents.

Notre charmant hôtel 3 étoiles de 18 chambres propose une atmosphère conviviale où nos clients se sentent comme chez eux. La Bärenstobe, notre restaurant gastronomique (45 places), ainsi que le bar Taverne (35 places) et la Lehnerstobe (45 places) pour les événements invitent à des plaisirs culinaires et des occasions spéciales.

Dans cet élégant hôtel 4 étoiles de 24 chambres, nous choyons nos clients avec une cuisine suisse traditionnelle dans la Löwenstobe (50 places) et créons des expériences inoubliables dans la salle Löwensaal pour les événements. Le vaste espace extérieur peut accueillir jusqu'à 80 invités et offre un emplacement parfait pour profiter.

En 2025, nous avons inauguré notre luxueux hôtel 5 étoiles HUUS QUELL avec 30 chambres et suites. Depuis, nos clients profitent non seulement du restaurant unique Quell avec son concept de partage, mais aussi d'un impressionnant espace bien-être et soins de plus de 2 200 m² ainsi que du bar élégant Botanicum.
*
* Nettoyage et entretien des chambres et salles de bains des clients ou de la zone spa, bien-être et piscine selon les standards de qualité
*
* Assurer la propreté, l'ordre et l'hygiène dans toutes les chambres attribuées, les étages ainsi que les espaces publics ou dans la zone spa, bien-être et piscine

* Recharger les articles pour les clients, le linge et autres consommables ou les serviettes et autres matériels pour les clients selon les standards de l'hôtel

* Prendre soin de la zone spa et piscine et garantir une ambiance soignée et accueillante (selon le domaine d'intervention)

* Signaler les défauts techniques et réparations à la direction de l'entretien ménager

* Utilisation soigneuse et efficace des produits de nettoyage, équipements et matériaux

Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience within a high growth tech startup, spanning multiple functions rather than a single specialty.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have the right to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to opt out of AI-assisted review, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision.
Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com for any requests or questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page .

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a technical recruiter on our R&D team, you will drive full-cycle recruiting for open software engineering roles. In this fast-paced role, you will manage an active load of requisitions, guiding candidates through the hiring process with clarity, speed, and a commitment to quality.
We are looking for someone who is eager to build a career in technical recruiting, highly collaborative, and motivated to learn. You will have access to structured mentorship, supportive leadership, and real-time feedback to help you refine your skills. The candidates who thrive at Samsara are curious, adaptable, and focused on delivering a great experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own full-cycle recruiting: Manage the hiring process for software engineering roles from intake through offer
Execute with efficiency: Keep candidates moving through the process with clear communication, operational discipline, and consistent follow-through
Source proactively: Build diverse candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and targeted sourcing strategies
Partner with hiring managers: Run structured intake calls, align on candidate profiles, and maintain transparent communication throughout each search
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience: Represent Samsara with timely updates, clear next steps, and respectful communication at every stage
Use data to improve: Track pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and refine your sourcing and screening approach
Apply feedback quickly: Work closely with senior recruiters and managers to continually develop your recruiting skillset
Leverage AI thoughtfully: Use AI-based tools and recruiting technology to streamline repetitive tasks while maintaining a high-touch candidate experience

2-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house), with software engineering recruiting experience preferred
Proven ability to manage multiple open requisitions in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills with candidates and internal team members
Demonstrated growth mindset with a desire to seek out and act on constructive feedback
Proficiency with sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter and modern applicant tracking systems
Passion for building a long-term career in technical recruiting
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du marché des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : connecter les talents aux entreprises qui feront leur succès.
Depuis plus de 15 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans toute la Suisse, faisant de nous un partenaire de choix pour nos clients. Aujourd'hui, notre bureau genevois a besoin d'un soutien temporaire et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons Consultant\-e en Recrutement pour rejoindre notre équipe pour une période de 4 mois, potentiellement prolongeable.
Notre bureau est un mélange unique de dynamisme, de compétition, d'ambition et de bonne humeur, où chaque membre joue un rôle essentiel. Ce qui nous distingue ? Une culture d'entreprise forte, une orientation résultats sans compromis, des processus redoutablement bien huilés, et un engagement sincère envers nos candidats et clients.
Prêt/e à relever le défi ?
Tâches
En tant que Consultant\-e en Recrutement, tu seras le chef d'orchestre de tes processus, du recueil du besoin client jusqu'à l'accompagnement de tes candidats en mission. Concrètement, ton quotidien s'articulera autour de ces tâches :
Stratégie \& conseil client : échanger directement avec nos clients (en binôme avec l'Account Manager) pour comprendre leurs besoins. Loin d'être un simple exécutant, tu assumes un rôle d'expert pour les challenger et les orienter vers la meilleure stratégie d'acquisition.
Copywriting \& attraction : rédiger des annonces immersives, transparentes et ciblées. Fini le jargon purement corporate : tu parles le langage de nos candidats pour te démarquer et attirer les meilleurs talents.
Assessment \& sélection : conduire les entretiens et évaluer les candidats avec la rigueur de nos standards, en t'appuyant sur nos méthodes de recrutement scientifiques. Tu deviendras un\-e expert\-e dans l'analyse de nos tests psychométriques et cognitifs pour identifier le vrai potentiel au\-delà du simple CV.
Closing \& négociation : élaborer des dossiers complets et défendre tes profils face aux clients avec conviction. Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.
Onboarding \& partenariat : Garantir un suivi administratif irréprochable (contrats, permis, certificats, etc.). Sur le terrain, tu deviens le career partner de tes consultants, avec ce qu'il faut de fermeté et de bienveillance pour maintenir des relations durables.

Expérience : 0 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle, idéalement en contact avec des clients (stages et jobs étudiants).
Langues : Une maîtrise parfaite du français (langue maternelle) ainsi qu'un très bon niveau d'anglais (C1 minimum).
Digital native dans l'âme, tu es autonome et tu jongles avec les outils informatiques avec curiosité.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour découvrir les moments forts de l-année 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des ressources humaines a pour principale mission d-assurer le développement du capital humain de l-institution en perspective de l-évolution organisationnelle. Elle recherche constamment à innover, challenger et améliorer ses pratiques tout en basant sa stratégie sur l-expérience positive des collaborateurs et collaboratrices.

La politique RH des HUG se fonde sur le développement des compétences et des parcours professionnels en adéquation avec les besoins institutionnels et se concentre sur la prise en compte de la personne, de l-équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée et de la santé et sécurité au travail.
## Description du poste ##
Reportant au responsable de programme Qualité de vie au travail, vous rejoignez la Direction des ressources humaines et participez activement à la mise en œuvre de la « stratégie RH 2023-2028 ».
Intégré ou intégrée à l-équipe en poste, vous participez à la mise en œuvre des initiatives visant à favoriser les présences et à gérer les absences. Vous contribuez, au travers de l-analyse des données, à mieux comprendre les déterminants de l-absence et les pistes d-actions possibles. Avec le support d-un ou une statisticienne, vous contribuez à l-établissement de tableaux de bords, clés en mains, directement utiles aux managers de proximité et à l-ensemble de la fonction RH et partenaires.
Vous renforcez/améliorez le suivi des absences notamment en réalisant des évaluations prioritaires des départements/directions et des fonctions à risques tout en analysant de près les taux d-absences. De par votre vision globale des absences au niveau institutionnel, vous analysez les éventuels facteurs de risques, de manière proactive, pour des populations particulières ou des tendances en lien avec l-environnement/les conditions de travail.
Personne ressource pour conseiller, soutenir et accompagner les départements et directions dans la détection des freins au traitement efficient des situations complexes d-absences puis la mise en place de « démarches QVT », vous sensibilisez la fonction RH et les cadres de l-institution à l-importance de l-accompagnement du personnel en poste, en prenant soin des présents, des personnes en reprise, lors du retour au travail suite à une absence et des absences.
Pour réaliser vos objectifs, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les cadres de l-institution, les responsables des ressources humaines et leurs équipes, les ressources départementales dédiées à cette thématique (réseau de spécialistes RH en QVT), le Service de santé au travail et tous les autres acteurs et actrices.

Vous êtes titulaire d-un Bachelor complété par un CAS en ressources humaines ou une formation en qualité de vie au travail, santé au travail, case management ou formation jugée équivalente. Vous bénéficiez d-une formation type coaching, systémique ou autre outil jugé équivalent.
Vous possédez une expérience en gestion de situation ou projet complexe, en dynamiques de groupes et des connaissances approfondies en gestion des ressources humaines et/ou en psychologie du travail et des organisations.
Votre maîtrise de la pensée complexe et systémique, vos grandes capacités d-analyse et de synthèse, ainsi que votre excellente capacité de communication et de collaboration, vous permettent de vous épanouir dans la fonction.
Vous aimez animer, fédérer, influencer, convaincre et travailler en équipe. Responsable et autonome, vous savez évoluer en environnement stressant.
Nous vous proposons d-intégrer une petite équipe très transversale dans un projet stimulant phare pour l-ensemble des HUG.
